title: test(dogfood): re-measure the authz census for the approval record-lock read
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBRzZP1k46z6vHf1CGVyw2uH)_
Fixes #26400

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改 dogfood 的两个 authz 普查测试文件里的计数与说明文字，记下 #26361 新增的审批记录锁读取路由（81 行台账、rest-server 行 70 / 19 / 51、总盲点 65 / 70）。
- 为什么改：#26361 加了一条路由但没同步普查，`main` 的 Dogfood Regression Gate (1/3) 和 (3/3) 从那以后一直红，发版闸门读的正是这两条。
- 风险与回滚：只动测试文件，不动任何发布包和路由代码；回滚即 revert 本 PR，`main` 会回到红。
- 先看：`packages/qa/dogfood/test/authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts` 的 rest-server.ts 行（新盲点 50 → 51 的判定），其次台账行，再看 `authz-conformance.matrix.ts` 第 27 行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts test/authz-conformance.test.ts`，预期 2 个文件、108 个测试全绿（`main` 上是 10 个红）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Census bookkeeping for the route #26361 added, `GET {basePath}/approvals/records/:object/:recordId/lock` in `packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts`. Each figure below was measured with `deriveProbeFileCensus()` on this tree, not copied from the card or from the server seat's reading (6431978738). The reading agreed with the server seat on every figure it gave.

| Row / figure | Before | After | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `rest-route-ledger.ts` population / reachable / blindSpot | 80 / 80 / 0 | 81 / 81 / 0 | one new ledger row carrying `family: 'approvals'`, a family the other approval rows already carry |
| `rest-route-ledger.ts` `keys` | 18 | 18 | no new family, so no new key |
| `rest-route-ledger.ts` controls `route: '` / `family: '` | 80 / 80 | 81 / 81 | the same row |
| `rest-server.ts` population / reachable / blindSpot | 69 / 19 / 50 | 70 / 19 / 51 | **a new blind spot**: one direct `this.routeManager.register(` site in `registerApprovalsEndpoints`, outside `registerMetadataEndpoints` and the `/meta` subset, the same as its seven siblings |
| `rest-server.ts` controls `this.routeManager.register(` / `approvals-routes.ts: …` / `enforceAuth` | 62 / 7 / 115 | 63 / 8 / 116 | the new site, and its handler opens with `this.enforceAuth(…)` (the only `enforceAuth` line #26361 added) |
| `BLIND_SPOT_TOTAL_STATIC` / `_RUNTIME` | 64 / 69 | 65 / 70 | one call site and one runtime mount; it is a direct registration, not a route factory, so the 5-mount static/runtime delta holds |
| `authz-conformance.matrix.ts` docblock (the figure #17111 parses) | 80 rows / 18 families | 81 rows / 18 families | plus a line in the dated drift note |

Every edited figure has a provenance comment in the row, in the shape the earlier re-measurements use.

## Why

`Dogfood Regression Gate (1/3)` and `(3/3)` have been red on every `main` push run that runs them since #26361 (`6a2866af`). This is the main-red stop-bleed under convention ①. It moves the census forward and does not revert #26361.

## Tests

Both files, under the verify lock, on `1cc4fa20`:

<details><summary>before (origin/main b33dd25b): 2 files failed, 10 tests failed, 98 passed</summary>

```
Test Files  2 failed (2)
     Tests  10 failed | 98 passed (108)
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 1
AssertionError: expected 81 to be 80        (rest-route-ledger.ts population)
AssertionError: expected 70 to be 69        (rest-server.ts population)
control "route: '" moved in packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts: expected 81 to be 80
control "this.routeManager.register(" moved in packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts: expected 63 to be 62
"packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts: docblock says 80 rows, the table holds 81"   (#17111 pin and its 5 doctoring cases)
```
</details>

<details><summary>after (1cc4fa20): 2 files passed, 108 tests passed</summary>

```
Test Files  2 passed (2)
     Tests  108 passed (108)
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0 · held the lock 21s
```
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The order named a docblock figure in `packages/rest/src/rest-route-ledger.ts`. The figure the #17111 pin reads is in `authz-conformance.matrix.ts` line 27, so that is the one that moved. No `packages/rest/**` file changes, as the claim requires.
- Shards 1/3 and 3/3 were not run whole locally: the title carries no `!` and no `(narrowing)` arm, so the full battery is not owed. The two files above hold all 10 failures. The card's acceptance (the first `main` push run and the next scheduled run green) can only be read after landing.
- The census pins still sit outside PR and merge-queue CI, which is how #26361 merged green. Seat 1 answered that question on the card (6432031749). It is not in this PR.

## Verification

Local derived gate set (`dispatch-gates.mjs` on `1cc4fa20`, 50 families): 48 exit 0, 2 NOT MEASURED, 0 red.

<details><summary>NOT MEASURED (exit 3, prerequisite not met in this container)</summary>

- `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`: its positive control is pinned to a commit that this shallow clone cannot reach.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: it reads built output, and seven packages outside this diff have no `dist/`.

Both run in CI's `Lint & Repo Gates`. `--ran` reconciliation: `50 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 48 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED`.
</details>
